scope: App 1.6.1 room sensor page: the app's page api/local-monitor/raumsensoren lists every Home Assistant temperature sensor (name, entity ID, value, area through one fixed read-only template) with a search field and lets a Home Assistant administrator (checked through Core WebSocket config/auth/list, fail closed) choose per sensor Heizkreis 1, Heizkreis 2 or Weitere Räume with the existing flags, the mode and the circuit types; saving merges only the nine room options into the app's own options through the Supervisor (GET /addons/self/info, POST /addons/self/options; no new permission, hassio_api stays off), refuses cross-site requests (Origin/Referer below the ingress path, Sec-Fetch-Site, page token, JSON only, 16 KiB), validates with the 1.6.0 option rules and hands the selection to the running house monitor without a restart. Room monitoring rules, report, ingress proxying, the status endpoint and VM-health alerts are unchanged.
